# Get all restaurants in Paris
all_restaurants = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Get the names of all the restaurants
restaurant_names = all_restaurants.split(", ")

    f"Which of the following restaurants serve Chinese cuisine? {', '.join(restaurant_names)}",
    list[str]
)

# Get the prices of the Chinese restaurants

# Filter the Chinese restaurants with prices under 34 euros

# Get the operating hours of the affordable restaurants
operating_hours = check_restaurant_opening_hours(affordable_restaurants)

# Filter the affordable restaurants that are open on Mondays
open_on_mondays = [restaurant for restaurant, hours in operating_hours.items() if "Monday" in hours]

# Get the ratings and reviews of the restaurants open on Mondays
ratings_and_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(open_on_mondays)

# Get the addresses of the restaurants open on Mondays
addresses = get_restaurants_address(open_on_mondays)

# Find the restaurant with the best rating and reviews
best_restaurant = max(ratings_and_reviews, key=ratings_and_reviews.get)

# Print the details of the best restaurant
print("Restaurant Name:", best_restaurant)
print("Rating:", ratings_and_reviews[best_restaurant])
print("Address:", addresses[best_restaurant])
print("Price per person:", prices[best_restaurant])
print("Operating Hours:", operating_hours[best_restaurant])
```
